directional_assessment.assessment: The plan retains observed-fragment candidate ranking with traceable evidence, verification/recapture/stop behavior, separates historical adjacency/current fit/visible evidence, and makes GT offline. It assigns asset generation to VesselForge, physical fracture to PG-Frag, and orchestration/observation/training/diagnostics to A12.
directional_assessment.maturity_assessment: The integrated plan is broader than current proof; treat its full pipeline and scale as planned capabilities, not completed evidence.

alignment_risks.title: Contract completion could be overstated
alignment_risks.evidence: A12 closure requires a validator-backed VesselForge asset, PG-Frag job/result lineage, and A12 release/permission audit. Current toy proof and unqualified style do not establish the complete seam.
alignment_risks.action: Keep the toy result mathematical/interface-only and physical package count at 0 until the manifests and validators exist. Treat the plan’s 8–12 fragment count only as an integration-fixture size; actual fragment count must emerge from physics, and a fixed fixture count must not be enforced as fracture control.

alignment_risks.title: Candidate score could be read as truth or probability
alignment_risks.evidence: Uncalibrated values are ranking scores; an open-library result is conditional on current input/library; missing evidence is not conflict.
alignment_risks.action: Preserve multi-neighbor candidates and send low-observability/unknown cases through verification, recapture, or STOP.

alignment_risks.title: Truth and visible evidence could leak across the model boundary
alignment_risks.evidence: Historical adjacency, current fit, and visible correspondence have separate meanings; object/seed/pose/GT are audit-only.
alignment_risks.action: Build features from ObsPack and its quality whitelist; keep labels and hidden provenance in the offline audit path.

alignment_risks.title: Future physics/material and scale scope exceeds current proof
alignment_risks.evidence: PG-Frag expects backend-qualified material/defect/event inputs; background records rho=1 as uncalibrated. A12 scale and 31-axis plans are staged future scope.
alignment_risks.action: Keep local qualification small; defer bulk generation and avoid describing the 93-DOF cohesive toy as realistic fracture.
